title: 64c88ae4/T3: Published side-by-side analysis + bench results report
description:
Third task of story `64c88ae4`. Runs T1 and T2 end-to-end, merges the CSVs, produces the published analysis document.

## Deliverables

- **End-to-end run** driven by `benchmarks/run.sh` — emits two CSVs (gf2 side, reference side).
- **`benchmarks/analyze.py`** (or Rust equivalent) — merges CSVs, computes throughput ratios per operation, renders markdown tables.
- **`dev/bench_results/2026-XX-YY.md`** — the published run:
  - Hardware block (CPU model, L1/L2/L3, memory, kernel).
  - Methodology block (container image digest, compiler versions, library versions).
  - Tables: one per (operation family, field family), gf2 vs. fflas-ffpack vs. M4RI (where applicable), with throughput ratio column.
  - Narrative: where we hit targets, where we miss them, why.
  - Raw CSV attached (or linked to the bench artefact path).

## Success criteria

- [hard] Published markdown renders correctly (tables align, numbers have units).
- [hard] Every bench combo from T2 appears in the published tables.
- [hard] Methodology section contains the container digest, compiler versions, host info — fully reproducible.
- [hard] Narrative identifies at least one operation where we hit the `[aspirational]` targets from the epic and at least one where we do not; the latter has a concrete explanation.
- [hard] Markdown doc attached to story `64c88ae4` via `jit doc add`.

## Depends on

- `64c88ae4/T1` (container + reference harnesses).
- `64c88ae4/T2` (gf2 bench suite).
